en.title: Clinic Report
en.summary: The clinical side of the practice at this branch: what was done, what was agreed, who came back, and what is owed.

sections.heading: What it covers
sections.body:
Ledgers: Production by Dentist, Procedures by Service, Case Acceptance, Recalls, Receivables Aging, Cash Drawer Counts, Lab Turnaround.

Production is the fee of work completed in the range — what commission is paid on — not the money collected, which is the Money report's. Case acceptance is the share of answered quotes' value the patients agreed to. A recall still waiting after its date is counted as missed.

sections.heading: Using it
sections.body:
Receivables Aging is what is owed today on issued bills, whatever the range says — a debt has no date range. Over 90 days is the money most likely never to come in.

The report reads the branch chosen in the top bar, not the branch filter. Needs the reports.clinic permission.

sections.heading: Every report works the same way
sections.body: Set the date range and the filters at the top — both ends of the range are included, and the query follows you when you move to another report. Choose a section below the charts to load the rows behind them, then filter, print or export that table like any other in the system.

am.title: የክሊኒክ ሪፖርት
am.summary: በዚህ ቅርንጫፍ የሕክምናው ጎን፦ የተሠራው፣ የተስማማበት፣ የተመለሰው፣ እና ያለ ዕዳ።

sections.heading: የሚሸፍነው
sections.body:
መዝገቦች፦ ምርት በጥርስ ሐኪም፣ ሕክምናዎች በአገልግሎት፣ የሕክምና ዕቅድ ተቀባይነት፣ የተመላሽ ጥሪዎች፣ የዕዳ ዕድሜ፣ የገንዘብ መሳቢያ ቆጠራዎች፣ የላቦራቶሪ ጊዜ።

ምርት በክልሉ ውስጥ የተጠናቀቀ ሥራ ክፍያ ነው — ኮሚሽን የሚከፈልበት — እንጂ የተሰበሰበ ገንዘብ አይደለም።

sections.heading: አጠቃቀም
sections.body:
የዕዳ ዕድሜ ዛሬ በተሰጡ ደረሰኞች ላይ ያለ ዕዳ ነው፣ ክልሉ ምንም ቢል።

ሪፖርቱ በላይኛው አሞሌ የተመረጠውን ቅርንጫፍ ያነባል። የreports.clinic ፈቃድ ይፈልጋል።

sections.heading: ሁሉም ሪፖርቶች በአንድ መንገድ ይሠራሉ
sections.body: ከላይ የቀን ክልሉንና ማጣሪያዎቹን ያስቀምጡ — ሁለቱም ጫፎች ይካተታሉ፤ ወደ ሌላ ሪፖርት ሲሄዱም መጠይቁ አብሮ ይመጣል። ከገበታዎቹ በታች ያለውን ክፍል መርጠው ከበስተጀርባ ያሉትን መስመሮች ይጫኑ፤ ከዚያ እንደማንኛውም ሠንጠረዥ ያጣሩ፣ ያትሙ ወይም ወደ ውጭ ያውጡ።
